in_hebrew.name: מַלְיָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מַלְיָה נוֹגֵעַ בַּעֲמוֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַמַּלְכָּה, לְשׁוֹמֵר הַמִּצְוֹת וְהַתּוֹרָה. הַשֵּׁם מְיוֹחֵד לִקְרוֹב לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.

in_greek.name: Μαλιά
in_greek.meaning: Μαλιά - η βασιλική, η βασίλισσα, προστάτις των εντολών
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μαλιά συνδέεται με τη βασιλική οικογένεια και την προστασία των θρησκευτικών εντολών. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα αναφέρονται ως σύμβολα πνευματικής βασιλείας.

in_latin.name: Malia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Malia ad reginam et custodiam mandatorum pertinet. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen significat devotionem ad Deum et Ecclesiam.

in_english.name: Malia
in_english.meaning: Malia - A variant of Mary, meaning bitter or wished-for child

data.cultural_impact: The name Malia, with its regal and elegant meaning, has been popular among Christians since the early days of the faith. It was borne by several saints throughout history, including St. Malalia, a noblewoman and martyr who lived in Rome during the third century. Her story is one of courage and devotion in the face of persecution. Her name became a symbol of purity, grace, and strength, and was passed down through the generations as a beloved choice for Christian girls.
data.spiritual_significance: Malia is a name that represents the ideals of purity, grace, and devotion. It is a reminder that every Christian is a beloved child of God, a 'lady' in His eyes, deserving of love and respect. The name is a call to emulate the virtues of the saints who bore it, and to strive for a life of faith, hope, and charity. May we who bear the name Malia be a living testament to the love and mercy of God, and may we reflect His divine beauty in all we do.
